summary: E2E testing of the new Recruiting & Talent ID (Scouting) module - backend + frontend. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases PASS covering criteria-by-sport, prospects CRUD, pipeline stage move, observations add/delete, evaluation (overall_score + category_averages), AI recommendation (OpenAI), photo upload+serve (with auth & query-token), profile PDF (NCAA style), convert-to-athlete, and dashboard. Frontend: tab-scouting opens scouting-module; created prospect via prospect-form (form-name/form-sport/form-save-btn); detail dialog shows hero with Editar/Ficha PDF/Reclutar→Atleta buttons + observations input; Pipeline tab renders 4 kanban-col-{prospect|contacted|trial|decision} columns with cards; Evaluación tab loads select; Ranking tab shows stats + checkbox; Reclutar→Atleta dialog (convert-team-select + convert-confirm-btn) successfully converts prospect → DECISION/RECRUITED badge + 'Reclutado como atleta' indicator + toast '¡Reclutado! Ahora es atleta en Equipos.'.

issues: Radix Dialog accessibility warnings in console: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Cosmetic / a11y only, non-blocking. Wrap titles in VisuallyHidden or add DialogTitle/DialogDescription.

action_items: (Optional / a11y) Add <DialogTitle> (visible or VisuallyHidden) + DialogDescription to Scouting dialogs (prospect-form, prospect-detail, convert dialog) to remove Radix accessibility console warnings.

(Optional) ScoutingModule.js is 712 lines — still under the 700-line guideline by very little; consider splitting into sub-files (ProspectCard, EvaluationTab, RankingTab, PipelineKanban, AIPanel) for maintainability if it grows further.
critical_code_review_comments: ✓ All endpoints under /api/recruiting use Bearer auth via get_current_user dependency; ObjectId is consistently excluded ({_id: 0} in projections + _clean helper).
✓ Storage init uses Emergent object-store with 403→reinit fallback (sensible). Photo MIME type whitelist enforced (jpg/jpeg/png/gif/webp) and 8MB limit applied.
✓ AI recommendation correctly uses emergentintegrations LlmChat with provider/model mapping (openai→gpt-5.5, anthropic→claude-sonnet-4-6) and robust JSON-extraction regex fallback.
✓ Convert endpoint is idempotent (returns existing athlete_id if already converted) — prevents duplicate athlete creation.
✓ PDF route accepts auth via header OR ?auth= query (needed for <a href> download); same pattern for /files/{path}. Good UX.
⚠ recruiting.py is 788 lines — slightly over the 700-line file-size guideline. Could split storage helpers, criteria catalog, AI prompt builder, and PDF builder into submodules.
⚠ DialogContent missing DialogTitle/DialogDescription triggers Radix a11y console warnings (3+ occurrences during E2E run). Cosmetic.

⚠ get_current_user_dep() resolves lazily via local import inside the function — works, but a module-level dependency reference (Depends(get_current_user)) would be cleaner and avoid the indirection on every request.

⚠ overall_score is computed as a flat avg of every individual criterion score; if a category has more criteria (e.g. football technical=5, others=4), that category is implicitly weighted more. Consider averaging the category_averages instead for fairness.
seed_data_creation: Created 'TEST_E2E_Prospect' (Fútbol, converted to athlete) via frontend; backend test creates+deletes 'TEST_Prospect_QA' cleanly. The pre-existing 'Test Prospect' (score=83) was not modified.
